check-up and hygiene appointment booking Saturday rules

results.heading: Booking an appointment
results.text: New and existing patients can book by email or phone. Tell us what the visit is for (check-up, pain, hygiene, whitening) and two or three preferred days; reception confirms a time.

results.heading: Saturday
results.text: Saturday appointments are for check-ups and hygiene visits only; longer treatments are scheduled on weekdays.

results.heading: Visit length
results.text: Check-ups and hygiene visits take 30 minutes. Fillings take 45–60 minutes. Whitening takes 90 minutes.

args.query: Istanbul visit or out-of-town patient check-up; complaints; blood thinners procedures
Istanbul visit or out-of-town patient check-up; complaints; blood thinners procedures

results.heading: Before your visit
results.text: Eat normally unless we told you otherwise. Brush your teeth before coming. If you take blood thinners or have a heart condition, tell us when booking.

results.heading: Complaints
results.text: We take complaints seriously. Every complaint is read by the clinic manager, who replies personally within three working days.

results.heading: First visit
results.text: A first visit takes about 30 minutes and includes a check-up and, if needed, a panoramic X-ray. Please bring your ID and any recent X-rays.

args.subject: Your check-up and hygiene appointment in Kadıköy
args.body:
Dear Enes,

Thank you for getting in touch. I have requested a 30-minute check-up and hygiene visit for you on Monday 26 October 2026 at 10:00. The booking is pending confirmation by our team, and you will receive a confirmation once it is approved.

If that time does not suit you, these slots are also free:
- Tuesday 27 October at 10:00
- Monday 26 October at 12:00

Before your visit, please brush your teeth and eat normally. As you mentioned in your records that you take blood thinners, please let us know about any medication changes when you arrive, so the dentist is aware.

Kind regards,
Nova Dental Clinic reception

args.reason: Booking requested with a note in CRM about medication; no complaint. Escalating only for human confirmation of the queued booking and the blood thinner note being shared with the dentist.
